info.description: Role based access control provides you a way to apply granular level policy administration down to individual resources or resource groups. These operations enable you to manage role assignments. A role assignment grants access to Azure Active Directory users.
info.title: AuthorizationManagementClient

get.description: Get a role assignment by ID.

parameters.description: The fully qualified ID of the role assignment including scope, resource name, and resource type. Format: /{scope}/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/{roleAssignmentName}. Example: /subscriptions/<SUB_ID>/resourcegroups/<RESOURCE_GROUP>/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/<ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_NAME>
parameters.name: roleAssignmentId

get.description: List all role assignments that apply to a scope.

parameters.description: The fully qualified Azure Resource manager identifier of the resource.
parameters.name: scope

parameters.description: The filter to apply on the operation. Use $filter=atScope() to return all role assignments at or above the scope. Use $filter=principalId eq {id} to return all role assignments at, above or below the scope for the specified principal.
parameters.name: $filter

parameters.description: The skipToken to apply on the operation. Use $skipToken={skiptoken} to return paged role assignments following the skipToken passed. Only supported on provider level calls.
parameters.name: $skipToken
